The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 eb1a535a1d8a9dc4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: The tensor T is symmetric and trace-free, and B is fully symmetric and trace-free in every pair of slots. In particular div T = 0. The following identities hold: ∇lBijk − ∇iBljk = δljTik + δlkTij − δijTlk − δikTlj, (3.3) ∆T = mT, ∆w2 = 2mw2 + 2|B|2 , (3.4) ∇lpi = Tli − gδli, ∇lg = pl, (3.5) ∇s2 = 2Tp, ∆s2 = 2w2 . (3.6) On the open set {w > 0} one also has ∇lw = w−1 TjkBljk, |∇w| ≤ |B|. (3.7) The inequality |∇(w2)|2 ≤ 4w2|B|2 holds everywhere, including at w = 0.
